cards.name: [SETUP] Initial project scaffolding
cards.desc: Set up repo, initial commit structure, and base files.

cards.name: [INFRA] Docker & deployment pipeline
cards.desc: Configured docker-compose for dev and prod stacks, SSH-based GitHub Actions deploy workflow, VITE_API_BASE_URL build-time injection, localhost port binding.

cards.name: [AUTH] Auth, privacy, and share/invite system
cards.desc: JWT login with USER/ADMIN roles, bcrypt passwords, per-user match privacy, share tokens (cuid), and invite links.

cards.name: [INFRA] Health check endpoint + frontend page
cards.desc: Added /api/health backend endpoint and /health-check frontend page for uptime monitoring.

cards.name: [AI] Catan board graph, personality engine, and Gemini key rotation
cards.desc: Full board graph implementation, AI personality engine, and rotation across GEMINI_1–8 API keys for rate-limit resilience.

cards.name: [GAME] Longest road, per-player log, stop/delete match, agent cap
cards.desc: Implemented longest road tracking, per-player event log, ability to stop/delete a running match, and agent count limits.

cards.name: [GAME] Robber multi-move bug fix + longest road threshold fix
cards.desc: Fixed a bug where the robber triggered multiple moves and corrected the longest road threshold calculation.

cards.name: [AI] AI-generated match summary via Gemini
cards.desc: Replaced auto-generated text summary with a Gemini-powered narrative match summary.

cards.name: [GAME] Trait system — AgentTrait table and 3 new traits
cards.desc: Added Trait and TraitConflict DB tables, seed file, and 3 initial traits; improved trait-to-agent relational binding.

cards.name: [CI] CI test workflow
cards.desc: Added GitHub Actions workflow for automated backend test runs.

cards.name: [FEATURE] Bot ownership, privacy controls, and admin delete
cards.desc: Users can own bots, set match privacy, and admins can delete any match.

cards.name: [CI] Expand CI — backend build, frontend build, lint
cards.desc: Added backend build check, frontend build check, and ESLint gate to CI pipeline.

cards.name: [CLEANUP] Remove deprecated Agent.traits JSON field
cards.desc: Removed the legacy traits JSON column from the Agent model after migration to the relational AgentTrait table.

cards.name: [GAME] Catan Seafarers game mode
cards.desc: Full Seafarers implementation with ship edges, island VPs, agentic AI support, and distinct UI.

cards.name: [INFRA] Fix production Dockerfile — prisma db push missing flag
cards.desc: Added --accept-data-loss to prisma db push in the production Dockerfile to prevent deploy failures.

cards.name: [UI] Browser tab title and favicon
cards.desc: Updated the browser tab title and added a favicon.
